cues.zh: 我来自澳大利亚政府，有一个重要消息要宣布，随着我们进入
cues.en: Hello I’m from the Australien Government with an important announcement as we enter

cues.zh: 气候危机的下一阶段
cues.en: the next stage of the climate crisis

cues.zh: 特大火灾
cues.en: MASSIVE FIRES

cues.zh: 特大洪水
cues.en: MASSIVE FLOODS

cues.zh: 特大的胡说八道
cues.en: MASSIVE BULLSHIT

cues.zh: 随着局势崩溃，要求我们紧急减排的呼声日益高涨
cues.en: As things fall apart and calls grow for us to urgently reduce our emissions

cues.zh: 我们想出了一个公关活动，我是说技术
cues.en: we've come up with a PR campaign, I mean technology

cues.zh: 让我们看起来像气候英雄，实际上啥也没干
cues.en: that makes us look like climate heroes whilst doing sweet nada

cues.zh: 隆重推出碳捕集与封存
cues.en: Introducing Carbon Capture and Storage

cues.zh: 碳捕集与封存，简称CCS，是一个复杂的采矿过程
cues.en: Carbon Capture and Storage, or CCS, is a complex mining process

cues.zh: 化石燃料公司通过向政客的屁眼注入捐款
cues.en: whereby fossil fuel companies inject donations into the arseholes of politicians

cues.zh: 来拖延气候行动，让他们继续赚得叮当响
cues.en: to delay climate action and let them keep making the ching-ching

cues.zh: CCS包含两个关键阶段：捕集和封存
cues.en: CCS entails two key stages: Capture and Storage

cues.zh: 在捕集阶段，也叫国家俘获，化石燃料利益集团渗透
cues.en: In the Capture phase, also known as State Capture, fossil fuel interests infiltrate

cues.zh: 你们各级政府
cues.en: your Government at every level

cues.zh: 好让我们无视科学家，继续批准新的煤炭和天然气项目
cues.en: so that we’ll ignore scientists and keep approving new coal and gas projects

cues.zh: 但别担心，在封存阶段我们付钱给那些化石燃料公司
cues.en: But don’t worry, in the Storage phase we pay those fossil fuel companies

cues.zh: 数十亿美元把他们的排放埋到地下
cues.en: billions of dollars to bury their emissions underground

cues.zh: 有用吗？绝对有
cues.en: Does it work? Absolutely

cues.zh: 那些公司把数十亿美元深埋，深深地埋在他们的银行账户里
cues.en: Those companies store the billions of dollars deep, deep down in their bank accounts

cues.zh: 税务官员够不着的地方
cues.en: where no tax officer can reach them

cues.zh: 什么，他们封存的是碳吗？才不呢
cues.en: What’s that, do they store the carbon? Yeh nah

cues.zh: CCS从未达到我们为它设定的任何一个目标
cues.en: CCS has missed every single target we’ve set for it

cues.zh: 让我们来看看！
cues.en: Let’s take a look!

cues.zh: 二十年前，我们告诉你们，到今年CCS每年将捕获50亿吨二氧化碳
cues.en: Twenty years ago, we told you that by today CCS would capture 5,000 million tons of CO2 per year

cues.zh: 今天，全世界勉强只能捕获10吨
cues.en: Today, the world can barely capture 10

cues.zh: 这离目标差得太远，在这张图上你根本都看不到它
cues.en: Which is so far off target you can’t even see it on this graph

cues.zh: 而当你想起我们全球每年排放360亿吨
cues.en: And when you remember that our global emissions are 36 BILLION tonnes each year

cues.zh: 即使它达到了目标，它的贡献大约也就是……
cues.en: even if had met it’s target, it would contribute approximately...

cues.zh: 屁都没有
cues.en: FUCK ALL

cues.zh: 我们还说过，到今天会有一百个CCS项目在运行
cues.en: We also said there’d be a hundred CCS projects running by today

cues.zh: 今天，只有6个
cues.en: Today, there are only 6

cues.zh: 但最大的一个就在澳大利亚这儿——那它表现如何呢？
cues.en: But the biggest one’s right here in Straya - so how’s it been doing?

cues.zh: 我们给了雪佛龙6000万美元来捕获它的排放，而在2016年它捕获了……
cues.en: Well we gave Chevron $60 million dollars to capture it’s emissions and in 2016 it captured...

cues.zh: 屁都没有
cues.en: Fuck All

cues.zh: 屁都没有
cues.en: Fuck All

cues.zh: 屁都没有
cues.en: Fuck All

cues.zh: 但在2019年，它终于……被沙子堵住了
cues.en: But in 2019, it finally... got clogged up by sand

cues.zh: 迄今为止，Gorgon只捕获了其目标的30%——而这还只是它的加工排放
cues.en: To date, Gorgon has captured only 30% of it’s target - and that’s just it’s processing emissions

cues.zh: 如果把天然气最终燃烧时释放的所有排放也算上，它只捕获了勉强2%
cues.en: If you include all those released when the gas is finally burned, it captured barely 2%

cues.zh: 但嘿，雪佛龙把你给他们的那6000万美元100%存下来了
cues.en: But hey, Chevron stored 100% of that $60 million you gave them

cues.zh: 捕获与封存！
cues.en: CAPTURE AND STORAGE!

cues.zh: 而这还只是最新的失败案例
cues.en: And that’s just the latest fail

cues.zh: 在加拿大政府这边，我们花了大约十亿美元，就为了在这座电厂证明CCS可行
cues.en: Here at the Canadien Government we spent aboot a billion dollars to prove CCS works, at this power plant

cues.zh: 结果恰恰证明了它不可行，因为每年都达不到目标，是吧
cues.en: Except it proved it doesn’t, by failing to reach it’s target every single year, eh

cues.zh: 在美国政府这边，我们曾说这个项目能给我们带来清洁煤
cues.en: And here at the US Government, we said this one would give us Clean Coal

cues.zh: 结果拖了好几年，超支数十亿，最后放弃了，因为它啥也没净化
cues.en: It was years late, billions over budget, and then gave up coz it cleaned jack shit

cues.zh: 这个也一样
cues.en: As did this one

cues.zh: 而且不只是技术烂，经济上也烂
cues.en: And it’s not just the technology that sucks, the economics do too

cues.zh: 因为CCS太贵了，就算它有用——而它并没有用
cues.en: Coz CCS is so expensive that even if it worked, which it doesn’t

cues.zh: 实施起来对我们的伙伴来说也是亏本的
cues.en: implementing it would be unprofitable for our mates

cues.zh: 除非当然，我们让你来买单
cues.en: Unless of course we make you pay for it

cues.zh: 而这正是我们一直在做的，把40亿美元纳税人的钱砸在CCS上
cues.en: Which is exactly what we’ve been doing by blowing $4 billion of your tax dollars on CCS

cues.zh: 包括我们刚批准的这些新项目
cues.en: Including these new projects we just approved

cues.zh: 最妙的是，我们是通过挪用资金来支付它们的
cues.en: And the best part is we’re paying for them by diverting funds away

cues.zh: 挪用的是本该补贴真正气候解决方案的机构资金
cues.en: from agencies which are meant to subsidise actual climate solutions

cues.zh: 比如可再生能源和电动车
cues.en: Like renewables and EVs

cues.zh: 总结一下：我们让你掏钱给化石燃料公司减排
cues.en: So to sum up: we’re making you pay fossil fuel companies to reduce emissions

cues.zh: 方式是资助一项根本不减排的技术
cues.en: by funding a technology that doesn’t reduce emissions

cues.zh: 用的还是本该用于真正解决方案的税款
cues.en: with tax dollars that were meant for solutions that do

cues.zh: 去补贴那些压根不交税的公司
cues.en: to benefit companies that pay fuck-all tax in the first place

cues.zh: 碳捕集与封存！
cues.en: CAPTURE AND STORAGE!

cues.zh: 还有另一种让CCS盈利的办法：强化采油
cues.en: There IS another way to make CCS profitable: Enhanced Oil Recovery

cues.zh: 就是把捕集到的二氧化碳注入油层，把石油驱赶出来
cues.en: That’s when the captured CO2 is used to flush out oil from deposits

cues.zh: 那些石油原本太难开采
cues.en: which would otherwise be too hard to reach

cues.zh: 而这些石油一旦燃烧，释放的碳可能比捕集的还多
cues.en: Oil which once burned can release more carbon than was captured

cues.zh: 你可能会说这是胡扯，但我们称之为碳捕集利用
cues.en: You might call that bullshit, but we call that Carbon Capture Use

cues.zh: 所以我们给CCS加了个U
cues.en: Which is why we’ve added a U to CCS

cues.zh: 给了Santos数百万，让它在Moomba玩这一套，还称之为清洁能源
cues.en: Given Santos millions to pull off that trick at Moomba, and called it cLeAn EnErGy

cues.zh: 说到胡扯，你听说过清洁氢能吗？
cues.en: Speaking of bullshit, have you heard of Clean Hydrogen?

cues.zh: 去他的绿氢，那才是用可再生能源和水制成的零排放能源
cues.en: Fuck Green Hydrogen, the energy source with zero emissions made from renewables and water

cues.zh: 这才是“清洁氢能”：用煤或天然气制成，排放量比直接烧
cues.en: Here’s “Clean Hydrogen”: made with coal or gas which emits more than if you just burned

cues.zh: 那些该死的煤或天然气还要多
cues.en: the fucking coal or gas in the first place

cues.zh: 但别担心，它是“清洁”的——因为我们会用CCS把这个问题也埋掉
cues.en: But don’t worry, it’s “clean” - coz we’ll bury that problem too, with CCS

cues.zh: 这些只是我们用来逃避真正气候行动的众多新技术中的一部分
cues.en: And those are just some of the New Technologies we’ll be using to avoid taking real climate action

cues.zh: 把它们加进来，你就能清楚看到我们到底在干什么……
cues.en: And when you add them to the mix, you can clearly see what we’re all about...

cues.zh: 澳大利亚政府
cues.en: Australien Government

cues.zh: 由延长化石燃料时代并让你为此买单部授权
cues.en: Authorised by the Department for Prolonging the Fossil Fuel Era and Making you Pay For It
